job.title: Jobgether - Commerce digital Consultant Bloomreach CRM

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant | Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over five years of experience delivering large-scale eCommerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 & 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and end-to-end integration of PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven record of designing data pipelines, supporting production, and bridging business and technical teams to drive successful digital commerce initiatives.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Jobgether - Commerce digital Consultant Bloomreach CRM
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Jobgether because your focus on cutting-edge commerce solutions aligns with my passion for digital commerce transformation. With over five years of hands-on experience building and extending SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in eCommerce integration and API development.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, designing product catalogs, pricing and customer data flows for global eCommerce sites.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Created and exposed OCC REST APIs and built PIM-to-ERP data pipelines, ensuring seamless integration across SAP ERP, MDM and third-party systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs and automated tests, driving successful releases.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps
bullets.text: Managed CI/CD pipelines on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), performed production support and optimized database queries to improve performance.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Jobgether’s ambition to empower brands with best-in-class commerce platforms resonates with my experience delivering scalable SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for global enterprises. I am eager to apply my deep knowledge of eCommerce integration, API design and techno-functional consulting to help Jobgether expand its multi-platform capabilities and drive rapid time-to-market for its clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help Jobgether deliver seamless, high-performance commerce experiences across leading platforms and accelerate client success.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud consultant with 5+ years delivering eCommerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about Jobgether’s focus on digital commerce and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your SAP Commerce Cloud environment, implement OCC and Spartacus integrations, and establish robust PIM-ERP data pipelines to ensure reliable product data flow. My experience with CCv2 deployments and production support will reduce downtime and accelerate feature delivery.
tailoring.insight: I notice Jobgether emphasizes expertise across multiple leading eCommerce platforms; my deep SAP Commerce Cloud background and integration skills position me to quickly bridge gaps and extend your multi-platform strategy.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Commerce digital Consultant – Jobgether
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud consultant with over five years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am drawn to Jobgether’s commitment to leading eCommerce platforms and believe my expertise in SAP Commerce, API integration and techno-functional consulting can accelerate your projects. I can immediately contribute by enhancing your commerce integrations and supporting production stability. I have attached my CV and cover letter for your review and look forward to discussing how I can add value.
